edgeIds: merged graph: main e, local mainEdgeCount + e (= src/sim fromRoadSet, src/geom)
nodeIds: merged-graph node indices (graphFromRoadSets); they change with every rebuild, edge ids do not

layout.mouthS: Float32 x2 per edge: [sExit at the start junction, sStop at the end junction] (m along the edge; 0 / length where the node is not a junction)
layout.goreS: Float32 per edge: ramp wait point (m) where the ramp lane centre clears the mainline pavement by 1.3 m; -1 if the ramp is not a no-added-lane merge
layout.jFirstH/jCountH: junction-box hull points (x,z pairs in hull)
layout.mInfo: Uint32 x7 per movement: [inEdge, inLane, outEdge, outLane, firstPt, ptCount, preferred]
layout.mF: Float32 x4 per movement: [sIn (leave inEdge here), sOut (join outEdge here), connector length, turn angle rad (>0 right)]
layout.pts: Float32 x4 per connector point: [x, y, z, metres along the connector]
layout.conf: Uint32 x3 per conflict: [movementA, movementB, type 0 crossing / 1 merge (exits within a car width)]; movements sharing an entry lane are not listed (an ordinary queue). Entries after the last junction range (jFirstC/jCountC) are cross-junction conflicts between connectors of neighbouring junctions (crossingFix)
layout.confS: Float32 x2 per conflict: [metres along A, metres along B] where the paths meet
